name: Antarctica Station
description: A research station on a broad white ice shelf with a red-roofed main base, orange cabins, radio masts and a wooden dock, penguins and seals in the foreground, snow-dusted rocky hills and icebergs floating in the dark sea behind.
author: Claude
prompt: An Antarctic research station on broad white ice shelves, with a red-roofed main base as the landmark, small orange cabins, radio masts, a short wooden dock, snow-dusted rocky hills, and groups of low-poly penguins and a few seals in the foreground, with icebergs floating in the dark sea behind. (for the film: What if Antarctica melted completely?)
